services.desc: The following forms are available for you to fill out and submit via email or in person at the shop. Please remember to retain a copy for your records. This is the 2023 RSTC Approved Medical form for Scuba Diving Activities. It must be filled out before any dive training is begun. A Physician's Approval is required for any diver who has a potential or actual medical condition (if any question listed on Page One has an affirmative answer, AND the Page Two detail then requires a physician's release) that is deemed adverse to SCUBA diving.
